name: geometry-viewer
description: View 3D CAD models: open, inspect and picture STEP and STL files on this Mac.
long_description: Lets Claude open STEP and STL files on this computer, list their assemblies and parts, render pictures of them from any angle and in any drawing style, show parts alone or cut sections through them, and open them in the Geometry app.

tools.name: open_model
tools.description: Open a STEP or STL file and summarise it.

tools.name: render_view
tools.description: Render a picture: any view, style, parts alone, sections.

tools.name: open_in_viewer
tools.description: Show the model in the Geometry app.
